name: Boiler circulation pumps / forced-circulation pumps (HRSG, once-through, controlled circulation)

name: Boiler steam drum and mud drum
description: In drum-type water-tube boilers the upper steam drum is the point of steam/water separation and feedwater introduction, while the lower mud drum collects sediment; downcomers carry cooler dense water to the lower drum and risers return the heated mixture.
